capability: Size the task first, then pick the road
title: A small gate picks the road.

hook.picture: Close on a tiny line entering a huge looping road, coiling round and round while a cost counter climbs.
hook.words: A yes or no took ten minutes.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: A yes-or-no question took ten minutes and cost us.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: team lead reading this month's AI bill

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three lines of different sizes, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½, all down one road.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Every task takes the same road.

stakes.body: Money and minutes burned on easy questions; hard questions rushed.

solution_hint: Size the task first. Then pick the road.

metaphor.body: A gate at the start rings each line to size it, then sends it down one of three roads: short, branching or looping.

steps.picture: A gate at the start; a ring sizes each arriving line; behind it the road splits: short, branching, looping.
Push-in: the small line takes the short road, pod ✓ fast; the big knotted line takes the looping road, pod ✓.
steps.words: Small goes direct. Hard gets the loop.
steps.sound: low note short, high note held

steps.picture: A middle-sized line takes the branching road and tries a few ways at once.
steps.words: In between? Try a few ways.

steps.picture: The gate and its three roads sit labelled.

real_case.claim: meta-prompting-framework scores each task 0 to 1 for complexity: under 0.3 goes direct, 0.3 to 0.7 tries several approaches, over 0.7 iterates.

honest_limit.picture: A short-looking line with a deep knot inside is ringed small, sent down the short road; the pod answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: Short questions can hide hard ones.

not_this.body: The size guess can be wrong, too.

ending_pattern.body: FELT close shot: the same tiny line meets the gate, takes the short road and is answered ✓ in one beat; the cost counter barely moves.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT the tiny line coiled through the big loop while cost climbed; now in the same shot it takes the short road and the counter stays still.

end_belief.body: Ask how hard it is before you start.
